valuation_price_incompatible: Quote type or adjustment basis is incompatible
valuation_price_conflicting_splits: Holdings record different split ratios since this price
valuation_price_unknown: Price recorded after the knowledge cutoff
valuation_price_window: No compatible price within the allowed age
valuation_holdings_policy: Live holdings use prices dated no later than today. Prices over seven days old remain visible and are marked stale. Adjusted prices and bid/ask quotes are excluded.
valuation_report_policy: Prices use the latest eligible date, then same-day manual/override, exact and estimated priority. Only unadjusted quotes known at this read are used. Historical reports remain live.
valuation_gains_profile: Unrealized figures use the operational basis (each sale's recorded method) for positions held on {date}, priced with the latest eligible price on or before that date, in each position's cost currency. Positions reflect the book as corrected today. This is not a tax calculation.
valuation_gains_date_future: Valuation date cannot be after today.
valuation_statement_note: Per currency for {from} to {to}: unrealized gain the day before the period starts, realized gain and dividend income in the period, and unrealized gain at its end. Operational basis, latest eligible price on or before each date, source figures retain their currencies. Not a tax calculation.
valuation_statement_range_invalid: The start date must not be after the end date, and the end date cannot be after today.
valuation_statement_error: The period statement could not be loaded.
valuation_statement_empty: No positions, disposals or dividends in this period.
valuation_statement_needs_both: Needs both opening and closing figures
valuation_alternative_policy: As of {date}, using current effective history. Specific-lot choices and transfer depletions use the selected method. Read-only; not a tax calculation.
valuation_alternative_unavailable: Unavailable: missing price or unknown basis
valuation_alternative_empty: No gains or open positions to compare.
valuation_fx_age_invalid: Choose a whole number of days from 1 to 365.
valuation_fx_valuation_note: Convert each basis, proceeds, income and market-value component at the valuation date. Statement boundaries each use their own date. Original figures remain below.
valuation_fx_historic_note: Convert operational lot basis at its recorded original acquisition date, proceeds and income at their event dates, and market value at the valuation date. Unknown dates leave foreign gains unavailable. Original figures remain below.
valuation_fx_profile: {method} · live_raw_v1 · valuation {date} · FX age ≤ {days} days · each foreign component rounded half-up to currency precision.
valuation_fx_rate_gap: No eligible rate for {date}. Nearest earlier observation: {nearest}.
valuation_fx_noop: Same currency: exact value, no FX observation needed.
valuation_runs_note: Saved reports keep their original figures after corrections or price withdrawals. Open one to inspect or download it.
valuation_runs_load_error: Could not load the saved report.
valuation_runs_save_note: Save a fresh operational report using the applied dates and original currencies. Alternative methods and currency conversions are excluded.
valuation_runs_save_error: Could not save this report. Check the dates and try again.
valuation_runs_saved: Report saved. Its original figures are shown in Saved gains reports.
valuation_runs_frozen_note: These figures are frozen at the saved time. Live reports below use the current effective history.
valuation_person_pool_policy: Read-only method across all your accounts, valued on {date}. Pools stay separate by security, cost currency and long/short side. Internal transfers preserve the pool; each account shows its quantity and share of pooled basis. This is not a tax calculation: no same-day or 30-day matching rules apply.
valuation_statement_roc_scope: The period result is realized gain + gross dividend income + change in unrealized gain. It excludes return-of-capital excess and is not a complete economic return or a tax calculation.
valuation_statement_roc_receipts: Return-of-capital receipts in this payment period
valuation_statement_roc_excluded: Return-of-capital excess excluded from the result
valuation_statement_roc_coverage: Receipts: {receipts}; unresolved receipts: {unresolved}; unknown lot effects: {lots}.
valuation_statement_roc_timing: Receipts, associated basis reductions and excess are grouped by payment date. Basis changes on the effective date, which may be outside this period. These disclosures are not added to the result; adding the reduction would count it twice.
valuation_statement_roc_legacy: This saved statement predates return-of-capital disclosure. Receipt and excess coverage is unavailable, not zero. Its original figures are preserved.
valuation_statement_roc_fx_timing: The reporting-currency result also excludes return-of-capital excess and is not a complete economic return or tax calculation. Separate receipt and excess figures use payment-date FX; associated reductions use effective-date FX. With valuation-date conversion, all three use the closing date. Missing coverage leaves each affected figure unavailable.
valuation_statement_unclassified_note: Imported payments with unknown gross and withholding: {count}. Net cash only, not included in income or the total.
valuation_statement_unclassified_legacy: This saved statement predates unclassified dividend disclosure. Imported dividend cash with unknown gross is unavailable here, not zero. Its original figures are preserved.
valuation_statement_unclassified_fx: Reporting-currency income also excludes imported dividend payments with unknown gross ({count}). Their native cash is shown in each currency below.
